title: Hoist repeated validation only with a cross-boundary coherence proof

source.title: vLLM PR #55499 TRTLLM ragged-prefill regression fix
source.claim_scope: The source reports throughput recovery and an unresolved CPU/device boundary risk; target performance remains unproven.

implementation_recipe: Identify the scope over which the predicate is invariant.
Validate once at metadata construction and propagate an explicit proof/flag.
Revalidate or use a guarded path whenever another subsystem can mutate the boundary.
validation_recipe: Exercise all-valid, all-invalid and mixed rows.
Force host/device or producer/consumer metadata divergence.
Measure the repeated-call path and verify the fallback activates on mismatch.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: Repeated synchronization should disappear; metadata construction and proof maintenance become the critical boundary.
failure_modes: The producer validates stale host metadata while the consumer uses updated device metadata.
A skip-check flag outlives the scope in which the predicate was proven.
Rare invalid rows reach a kernel that assumes all rows active.
scope_limits: Validation may be hoisted only across operations that cannot invalidate its predicate.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: Every repeated consumer call recomputes or synchronizes to validate the same predicate.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: one metadata epoch containing multiple consumer calls
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: Conjoin producer-side validity with equality of every boundary representation used by the consumer.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Enable skip-check only for the matching epoch; otherwise enter the guarded validation path.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: One validation per metadata epoch instead of per consumer call.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: Repeated host-device synchronization is removed from the inner call sequence.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: May add a small epoch/proof token while removing repeated synchronization.
anti_patterns: validation against a different metadata representation

candidate_archetypes.name: metadata-epoch validation proof
candidate_archetypes.template: Validate once per immutable metadata epoch and skip only when producer and consumer boundary identities match.
